DevOps Engineer – Network Product Services
 We’re excited to welcome new DevOps Engineers to our Network Product Services team! In this role, you’ll help shape, build, and support the platforms that power our network automation products. We work closely across engineering, architecture, SRE, operations, and security, and we’re committed to creating systems that are reliable, scalable, secure—and increasingly intelligent through agentic workflows and AI-driven automation.
You’ll make a meaningful impact by contributing to our CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and operational reliability, while also helping us advance automated incident response, intelligent triage, and self‑healing capabilities.
 What You’ll Do
 CI/CD & Automation
 You’ll design and maintain modern CI/CD pipelines that streamline how we build, test, and deploy network automation products. You’ll work with tools like Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CloudFormation to express infrastructure as code, automate provisioning, and improve the overall deployment experience. We value engineers who continually push automation forward and reduce manual work wherever possible.
 Cloud Infrastructure & Operations
 You’ll manage and optimize cloud environments across Azure, AWS, or GCP, and support containerized workloads running on Kubernetes and Docker. You’ll enhance observability with monitoring and logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog, and you’ll partner with our security teams to maintain strong security practices across all layers of our stack.
 Network Operations & Support
 Our network automation products depend on strong infrastructure, and you’ll play a key role in supporting and improving those systems. You’ll help diagnose and resolve issues tied to networking fundamentals and infrastructure interactions, contribute to runbooks and SOPs, and take part in our on‑call rotation to support 24x7 production environments. We learn from every incident—and you’ll help us implement fixes and preventive measures.
 Teamwork & Continuous Improvement
 We believe great products come from great collaboration! You’ll work directly with software engineers, SREs, and operations teams to integrate features, improve reliability, and iterate quickly. We participate in Agile ceremonies, reflect openly, and constantly look for ways to improve how we operate. We stay curious and keep up with emerging DevOps trends, tools, and automation technologies.
 Required
 What You Bring
A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
Hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or a similar role
Strong background with CI/CD platforms such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps
Proficiency with Kubernetes and Docker
Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Helm
Solid understanding of Azure, AWS, or GCP
Programming/scripting knowledge in Python, Bash, or similar
Understanding of networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, load balancing)
Ability to participate in an on‑call rotation
Strong troubleshooting skills and attention to detail
Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team environment
 Preferred
Experience designing agentic workflows or AI‑driven automation
Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude) and prompt engineering
Knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP)
Understanding of RAG patterns and vector databases
Experience with network automation tooling
Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK stack
Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (Azure, AWS, CKA, DevOps certs)
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Understanding of compliance or regulated industries
 Who We Are
 We care deeply about building reliable, inclusive, and innovative systems. We believe in automation that empowers teams, collaboration that strengthens outcomes, and technology that adapts to the future of networking. We’re passionate about learning, improving, and making an impact together!
 Equal Opportunity & Accessibility
 We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels supported and included. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, we’re happy to provide them—just let us know.
